distinguishing_fact: The laboratory analysis affirmatively found the yarn samples to be unbleached and not mercerized, placing them under 5205.12.1000 rather than the basket 'Other' line 5205.12.2000.
reasoning: The merchandise consists of two samples of 100% cotton yarn (1-ply, carded open-end spun, not combed, unbleached, not mercerized). Under Note 4 to Section XI, because the yarn and support packages weigh over 125 grams (1,126 g and 516 g), they are not put up for retail sale and are classified under heading 5205. Both samples have metric numbers exceeding 14 Nm but not exceeding 43 Nm (20.1 Nm and 27.03 Nm respectively), directing them to subheading 5205.12. At the 8-digit level, because the yarn is unbleached and not mercerized, it is classified under subheading 5205.12.10 (statistical suffix 5205.12.1000).

distinguishing_fact: Subheading 8424.41.90 covers self-contained portable sprayers with a capacity not exceeding 20 liters. Because the FXS8/680 has a 600-liter capacity tank, it is excluded from 8424.41.90 and falls under 8424.41.10.
reasoning: The FXS8/680 is a complete, operable tractor-mounted horticultural sprayer comprising a 600-liter tank, diaphragm pump, and 10 nozzles for spraying liquid pesticides/fertilizers. Candidates under headings 8524 (flat panel display modules), 8529 (parts), and 8549 (electrical waste and scrap) are sweep candidates created in the 2022 HS update and are inapplicable to complete mechanical spraying appliances. By application of GRI 1 and GRI 6, the sprayer is classified under heading 8424, subheading 8424.41 as a portable agricultural or horticultural sprayer. Within 8424.41, 8424.41.1000 specifically covers sprayers except self-contained sprayers with a capacity not over 20 liters. Given its 600-liter tank capacity, the item is properly classified under 8424.41.1000.

distinguishing_fact: Heading 8549 covers electrical and electronic waste and scrap (such as spent or scrap batteries), whereas the subject merchandise is a newly manufactured, functional rechargeable lithium-ion battery properly classified under heading 8507.
reasoning: The merchandise is a prismatic lithium-ion battery (accumulator) comprising two rechargeable lithium-ion cells welded in series within an aluminum housing, rated at 3.2 V and 228 Ah, designed for general power applications. Under GRI 1, the goods are prima facie classifiable under heading 8507, which covers electric accumulators/storage batteries. Within heading 8507, subheading 8507.60.00 specifically eo nomine provides for 'Lithium-ion batteries.' The candidate subheadings under heading 8549 are sweep provisions for electrical and electronic waste and scrap created in the 2022 HTS revision and do not apply to intact, functional batteries.
